name: Social Media Management Suite
title: Social Media Management Excel Suite: Clients, Content Calendar, Approvals, Community, Analytics, Ads, Creators, Billing, 15 Languages
headline: Run a social media management business from eight connected Excel workbooks
seo_title: Social Media Management Excel Templates – Calendar, Reports, Ads
seo_description: Eight Excel workbooks for social media managers and small agencies: clients, content calendar, production, community, analytics, ads, creators and billing. 15 languages.
description:
A social media business runs on many small promises: twelve posts a month for one brand, a reel waiting for approval for another, an inbox that needs answers within the hour, an ad budget that must not run out before month-end, and a report every client expects on time. They hide in chat threads and spreadsheets that never agree with each other.

This suite gives a freelance social media manager or a small agency eight connected workbooks with sample data already inside: clients and contracts, strategy and the content calendar, production and approvals, publishing and community, analytics and reports, paid ads and budgets, creators and partnerships, and the team, time, billing and profit behind it all. Every page fills in by itself from what you type: totals, due dates, approval delays, engagement rates, alerts, dashboards and charts.

Each workbook comes in 15 languages, with documents, checklists and ready WhatsApp messages for clients, the team and creators. Clear the sample rows, type your own, and every brand you manage is in one place.
features: Client register with packages, scope used and renewals
Onboarding, brand guidelines and platform access status (no passwords)
Content calendar with pillars, themes and posting frequency
Production pipeline from idea to published with approval rounds
Publishing log, missed posts and best times by platform
Community inbox with response times, reviews and crisis log
Monthly results per client and platform with goals vs actual
Post performance, top posts and format comparison
Ad campaigns, daily spend, cost per result and return on ad spend
Creator database, deliverables, usage rights and payments
Timesheets, invoices, receivables and profit per client
Cash flow forecast, price increases and hiring planner

faq.a: No. The files open in Microsoft Excel on Windows or Mac and in LibreOffice Calc, which is free.

faq.q: Does it suit a freelancer and an agency with a team?
faq.a: Yes. The team columns work for one person or many; the sample data shows a small agency with seven team members and thirty brands.

faq.q: Can I replace the sample data with my own?
faq.a: Yes. Clear the sample rows and type or paste yours; lists, formulas, alerts, dashboards and calculators update by themselves.

faq.q: Does it connect to the social platforms?
faq.a: No. It works with the numbers you copy from each platform's insights; no logins and no passwords are stored.
Open the workbook in your language, fill the yellow cells on the Start sheet, then follow the How to use it steps.

faq.q: Are there macros or a subscription?
faq.a: No macros and no add-ins: only formulas, so the files are safe to open. One payment, instant download.
